meta.uv: normalised virtual frame holding every view (meta.space.frame), TD convention: u left->right, v bottom->top
meta.d: direction from the camera, home view coordinates: x right, y down, z forward (the show position's axis)
meta.hu_hv: where the LED is in the home view (the show position), TD convention; null behind it, outside 0..1 out of view

frame.kind: virtual pinhole: every view rotated into one frame aimed at the middle of the lights

prior.note: decodes that disagree with the previous map moved to the new camera pose were replaced by that prediction
